title: Murder on the Border
start: Speak to Aster in the Town Hall of Fort Forinthry.

ironman.t: 20 Woodcutting (To chop willow logs for the planks)

items.t: 24 limestone bricks to make stone wall segments
144 willow planks to make willow frames

kills.t: One assassin that scales to your combat level (optional)

rewards.t: 8000 Construction XP lamp (Skill must be level 40 or higher)
rewards.l: Construction XP lamp (Murder on the Border)

rewards.t: 3000 Skill XP lamp (Skill must be level 30 or higher)
rewards.l: Prismatic XP lamp (Murder on the Border)

rewards.t: The ability to build all three tiers of the Fort Forinthry Kitchen

steps.t: Talk to Aster in the Town Hall at Fort Forinthry. [Chat: 1 Talk about quests... › 1 Talk about 'Murder on the Border'. › Accept › Any › Any]
Talk to Bill about building the Kitchen. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Murder on the Border'.]
Check plans on the Fort Forinthry blueprints table near Bill and choose Kitchen (Tier 1).
p: Area where the Kitchen will be built.

steps.t: Build the Kitchen located east of the Town Hall. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Aster. [Chat: 1 Talk about quests... › 1 Talk about 'Murder on the Border'.]
Click the light blue portal south of the well to start the cutscene. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Watch the cutscene and welcome the guests as they arrive. [Chat: ~ › ~ › ~ › ~]
p: King Roald thanks the adventurer for inviting them to Fort Forinthry.

steps.t: Talk to three groups of guests in the Town Hall:

sub.t: Any guest in the western room.
Any character in the central room. floor 0. [Chat: ~]

steps.t: Talk to Aster in the central room on floor 0. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Yes, let's start the feast'.]
Converse with the guests during the feast cutscene. [Chat: ~ › ~ › ~]
Once the cutscene is completed, continue the conversation with Aster to obtain a mystery journal. [Chat: ~]
(1/8) Go to the Kitchen and investigate the nut roast located on a table in the southeast corner of the room.
(2/8) At the north-west part of the Fort, by the northern gates, investigate the strange satchel beside the rock (southeast of the guards). [Chat: ~]
(3/8) Talk to Simon outside of the Town Hall [Chat: 2 Link a clue to Simon.] and Link "How to Poison Dummies for Dummies".
(4/8) Investigate the half-buried box in the northeastern corner of the fort.
Detect the poison:

sub.t: Investigate the strange satchel again and take a poison detection potion (base). [Chat: 1 Take a vial. › 2 Leave.]
Search the supply cupboard in the Kitchen and take a hollyhock. [Chat: 1 Take hollyhock. › 4 Leave.]
Use the hollyhock on the vial to create an unheated poison detection potion (hollyhock).
Heat the vial on the range.
(5/8) Use the poison detection potion (hollyhock) on the duke's meal (meat pâté) on the dining table. [Chat: 2 Use it on the duke's meat pâté.]

steps.t: (6/8) Talk to King Roald in the Chapel. [Chat: 1 Talk to King Roald. › 1 Did you notice anything suspicious? › 3 That's all for now.]
(7/8) Go to the Command Centre and speak to Duchess Alba [Chat: 2 Link a clue to Duchess Alba], and Link the "Nut Roast".
(8/8) Talk to Bianca outside the chapel [Chat: 2 Link a clue to Bianca.], and Link the "Stolen Jewellery". [Chat: ~]
Ascend to the top floor of the Town Hall and talk to Aster.
Fight the assassin.

sub.t: If you die, Princess will kill the assassin for you.

steps.t: Talk to Aster after defeating the assassin.
Search the assassin's body for an assassin's letter then talk to Aster.
(1/8) Speak with anyone outside by the well. [Chat: 1 Talk about the assassin. › ~]
(2/8) Investigate the wax seal outside the northwestern corner of the Chapel.
(3/8) Speak to Iris in the Workshop [Chat: 2 Link a clue to Iris.] and Link the "Strange Seal" to obtain the amulet of spanielspeak clue. [Chat: ~]
(4/8) In the Town Hall, investigate the burnt parchment on the floor near the fireplace.
Find the unearthed coffer:

sub.t: Talk to Princess, the dog, just east of the stonecutter outside the Workshop [Chat: 2 Link a clue to Princess.] and Link the "Amulet of Spanielspeak".
Go to the northwestern corner of the fort next to the ladder and speak to Princess. (Princess will follow you, you may have to take a wide way around to get her unstuck on corners.)
Investigate the miscellaneous items that appear nearby.
Stand near Queen Ellamaria outside by the well, then speak to Princess again.
Stand at the altar in the chapel, then speak to Princess once again.
(5/8) Investigate the unearthed coffer (which may be underneath Aster, Princess, or your character).

p: Simon is killed by dark beasts.

steps.t: (6/8) Talk to Duchess Alba in the Command Centre. [Chat: 1 Talk to Duchess Alba. › 2 What's your beef with King Roald? › ~ › 3 That's all for now.]
Talk to Rodney outside the Workshop and ask about Ellamaria. [Chat: 1 Talk to Rodney. › 2 Ask about Ellamaria. › 3 That's all for now]
(7/8) Speak to Rodney again [Chat: 2 Link a clue to Rodney.] and Link the "Scorched Will"

(8/8) Speak to Queen Ellamaria outside by the well and ask about being friends with Bianca. [Chat: 1 Talk to Queen Ellamaria. › 2 I heard you were once friends with Bianca. › 4 That's all for now.] and finish speaking with Aster. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm ready.]
Talk to anyone in the courtyard. [Chat: ~ › ~ › ~ › ~]
Identify the murderer as Bianca. [Chat: 5 Bianca Dunnet › ~]
Talk to King Roald. [Chat: 1 End the banquet.]
Talk to Aster in the Town Hall. [Chat: 1 Talk about quests... › 1 Talk about 'Murder on the Border'. › ~]
Talk to Rodney in the Kitchen. [Chat: ~]
Quest complete!
